lessonPractice.title: 工具栏只有一个下载图标，需要在鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦时补一句“下载报告”。怎样补充这句说明？

options.label: 给图标关联一个可悬停和聚焦触发的文字提示
options.feedback: 短说明用于补充图标含义，且鼠标与键盘都能触发，符合文字提示的用途。

options.label: 打开带下载格式选择和确认按钮的气泡卡片
options.feedback: 题目只需要解释图标，不需要包含选择和操作的交互式浮层。

options.label: 点击下载后再用消息提示说明这个图标
options.feedback: 用户需要在操作前识别按钮，点击后的消息无法帮助他提前理解图标。

en.title: An icon-only toolbar button needs the label Download report on mouse hover or keyboard focus. What should be used?

options.label: Attach a text tooltip that opens on both hover and focus
options.feedback: A short label explains the icon, and supporting both mouse and keyboard makes the hint reachable.

options.label: Open a card with format choices and a confirmation button
options.feedback: The task only needs to explain the icon, not an interactive layer with choices and actions.

options.label: Explain the icon in a message only after download is clicked
options.feedback: People need to understand the control before acting, so a message after the click arrives too late.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 给下载图标增加文字提示“下载报告”，鼠标悬停和键盘聚焦都能打开，移开或失焦后关闭。不要把下载格式或错误信息藏进提示里，并验证触屏仍能识别按钮作用。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add a Download report tooltip to the icon, opening on hover and keyboard focus and closing on leave or blur. Keep format choices and errors outside it, and verify the action remains understandable on touch.

use.t: Give a short hint for an unfamiliar control
Show the full value of truncated text

dont.t: Hide required instructions inside a tooltip
Put links or forms inside it
Repeat a label that is already visible
Support hover only and ignore keyboard or touch

comparison.title: Tooltip vs Popover: which one should you use?
comparison.decision: Use a Tooltip for a short, read-only explanation. Use a Popover for longer information or controls people need to interact with.

dimensions.label: Content scope
dimensions.other: Longer information, links, buttons, or form controls.

dimensions.label: Interactivity
dimensions.current: Read-only and available on keyboard focus as well as hover.
dimensions.other: Can remain open while someone clicks or types inside it.

dimensions.label: Best fit
dimensions.current: Explaining an icon button, truncated title, or abbreviation.
dimensions.other: Showing contextual details, a small set of options, or a compact form.

scenario.title: Configuring a file export button
scenario.text: If a download icon only needs to display the text “Download report” on hover or focus, choose a Tooltip. If clicking the icon lets users choose between PDF and CSV before initiating the export, use a Popover so they can interact with the options.
